spec_match.rationale: Accurately frames the feature's deliberate page-invisibility (proven by a real property-enumeration probe) and points at the real owner-side surfaces: Transparency Report lookup, Search Console security issues, and the repair guide.

interactive.rationale: Domain input rewrites the real Transparency-Report URL live; the six-item audit checklist tracks progress in an aria-live line; the absence probe runs on load.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the absence proof plus real links and a checklist; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: The probe would surface unexpected members if a future build ever exposed any (and says to report it); empty domain input falls back to a placeholder; the completed checklist explicitly disclaims a guaranteed clean verdict.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5427561449521152; the toolkit links transparencyreport.google.com, Search Console, and the Search Central repair guide.

conformance.rationale: The suite's no-web-exposed-surface assertion is this page's probe verbatim; the UI-tier contracts stay manual.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: probe found 0 Safe-Browsing members (honest pass), domain input rewrote the link to the typed domain, checklist progress updated 0→2/6; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: ssw-no-runtime-surface and ssw-checklist-progress asserts fire with real values.

design_system.rationale: Link cards ≥44px with accent-blue on paper (AA); CSS variables only; checklist uses native checkboxes.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled text input, labelled checkboxes, progress as role=status aria-live; links are real anchors with descriptive text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column stack throughout; long generated URLs wrap (overflow-wrap); 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

guidanceConsulted.query: text input live derived link accessible label
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label inputs programmatically and derive outputs on input without a submit step.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The domain field has a <label for> and rewrites the lookup link on every keystroke.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce progress changes via a live region with text, not colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Progress line is role=status aria-live and states n/6 textually; completion adds a text caveat.

guidanceConsulted.query: long generated urls wrapping mobile link cards
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: overflow-wrap:anywhere on long tokens inside bordered cards.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied to link cards and code; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the absence probe, live link generation, and checklist all behave on Chromium 141 with a clean console at both viewports. No open questions — the page's claims are all either live-proven or linked to canonical Google documentation.
